email.common.noReply: This email was sent from a no-reply address. Please do not reply.
email.common.ignoreIfMistake: If you received this email by mistake, you can safely ignore it.
email.auth.signInCode.subject: {code} is your Okkey sign-in code
email.auth.signInCode.line2: This code will expire in {minutes, plural, one {# minute} other {# minutes}} and can only be used once. Never share this code with anyone.
email.auth.signInCode.ignore: If you did not request this code, you can ignore this email.
email.auth.signInCode.plain: Your Okkey verification code is {code}. This code will expire in {minutes, plural, one {# minute} other {# minutes}} and can only be used once. Never share this code with anyone.
email.auth.emailChangeCode.subject: {code} is your Okkey email change code
email.auth.emailChangeCode.beforeCode: Your Okkey email change verification code is:
email.auth.emailChangeCode.line2: Use this code to confirm your new email address. It will expire in {minutes, plural, one {# minute} other {# minutes}} and can only be used once. Never share this code with anyone.
email.auth.emailChangeCode.ignore: If you did not request an email change, you can ignore this email.
email.auth.emailChangeCode.plain: Your Okkey email change verification code is {code}. Use this code to confirm your new email address. It will expire in {minutes, plural, one {# minute} other {# minutes}} and can only be used once. Never share this code with anyone.
email.device.approval.subject: New device sign-in — approval required
email.device.approval.lead: A new device is requesting access to your Okkey account. Review the details below and approve only if you recognize the device.
email.device.approval.noteNoUrl: Open Okkey on a trusted device to approve.
email.device.approval.noteBlockIfNotYou: If this device is not yours, block it immediately in device settings and strengthen your account security.
email.workspaceInvite.subject: Invitation to workspace “{workspaceName}”
email.workspaceInvite.intro: {inviter} invited you to workspace “{workspaceName}”. Accept the invitation to join the workspace and access shared vaults.
email.twoFactor.enabled.subject: Two-factor authentication enabled on Okkey
email.twoFactor.enabled.line1: Two-factor authentication was enabled on your Okkey account ({whenUtc} UTC).
email.twoFactor.enabled.line2: You will need your authenticator app for future sign-ins. If this was not you, contact support and change your password immediately.
email.twoFactor.backupRegen.subject: Okkey backup codes were regenerated
email.twoFactor.backupRegen.line1: Your Okkey backup codes were regenerated ({whenUtc} UTC).
email.twoFactor.backupRegen.line2: Previous codes are no longer valid. New codes are only shown in the app — we never list them in email. Store them somewhere safe.
email.device.recovery.subject: Account recovery via trusted device — approval needed
email.device.recovery.lead: Someone started master-password recovery using your trusted devices. Approve only if you started this request.
email.device.recovery.noteNoUrl: Open Okkey on a trusted unlocked device, then open Settings → Recovery to approve.
email.device.recovery.noteIgnore: If you did not start recovery, keep your vault locked on other devices and do not approve.
email.contacts.recovery.subject: Help restore an Okkey account
email.contacts.recovery.lead: A trusted contact needs you to release your recovery share so they can restore access.
email.contacts.recovery.noteNoUrl: Open Okkey and unlock your vault — a popup will ask you to release your share.
email.contacts.recovery.noteIgnore: If you do not recognize this request, do not release your share.
email.contacts.invite.subject: Invitation to be a trusted contact on Okkey
email.contacts.invite.lead: {inviter} invited you to be their trusted contact on Okkey.
email.contacts.invite.detailLine: Inviter account: {inviterEmail}. Trusted contacts can help restore access if the owner loses their master password.
email.contacts.invite.whatToDo: Open Okkey, unlock your vault, then open Settings → Recovery to accept or decline.
email.contacts.invite.noteNoUrl: Open Okkey, unlock your vault, then open Settings → Recovery to respond to the invitation.
email.contacts.invite.noteIgnore: If you do not know this person or do not want to help, decline in the app.
email.planChangeRequest.subject: Plan request {plan} — {workspaceName}
